name: PH Dispatch
description: E1 demo pack — entitlement-aware RMA dispatch for the fictional Meridian Devices support org. Blocks on-site truck rolls for depot-tier tenants (Northwind) and self-serve tenants (Fabrikam), suggests mail-in RMA or remote session, emits a cost-avoided receipt. Backs docs/demo-scripts/E1-the-140-dollar-ticket.md.

rules.description: Block on-site RMA dispatch for depot-tier tenants; suggest mail-in RMA.
rules.message: Tenant entitlement is depot — dispatch requires onsite. Try rma.mail_in instead. Cost avoided: $135.50.
rules.recommendation: Re-plan as rma.mail_in with a prepaid shipping label. Real dispatch costs $140; mail-in costs $4.50.

enforcement.guarantee: Blocks dispatch.rma calls for tenants without onsite entitlement on surfaces marked hard or conditional when their listed dependencies are satisfied.
requires: Sierra (or any calling agent) invokes MCP guard_check with tool_name='dispatch.rma' and tool_input including the tenant id, OR the dispatch.meridian.com API is routed through the Conduct Guard Proxy
known_limitations: Demo pack uses a hardcoded tenant allowlist in match_pattern rather than a live entitlement lookup — see 'meridian-dispatch.yaml' for the intended require: tenant.entitlement_tier shape
MCP cannot enforce actions the agent does not submit to guard_check

rules.description: Block both dispatch and mail-in for self-serve tenants; remote session only.
rules.message: Tenant is self-serve tier — physical fulfillment not covered. Route to remote.session. Cost avoided: $105.00.
rules.recommendation: Offer a remote screen-share session ($35) or AI-only walkthrough (cents) instead of any physical fulfillment.

enforcement.guarantee: Blocks physical-fulfillment calls for self-serve tenants on surfaces marked hard or conditional when their listed dependencies are satisfied.
requires: Sierra invokes MCP guard_check before firing dispatch.rma or rma.mail_in, OR the fulfillment API is routed through the Conduct Guard Proxy
known_limitations: Demo pack — see meridian-dispatch.yaml for the intended require: tenant.entitlement_tier shape
MCP cannot enforce actions the agent does not submit to guard_check
